Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

It sounds like proving your reliability matters to you, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance. How will you substantiate a materially stronger, binding quality commitment with a corrective-action report?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 800 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 1500 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
We hear you on the quality and our guys are working on the corrective actions; we can commit to 1500 ppm to show we mean it.
The volume increase is good, but we really need you to stick to your promise of paying on time, as cash flow is tight for us.
With the 1500 ppm commitment and your promise to pay on time, we can offer €46.50 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
